card.title: Is this wallet sanctioned?
card.sub: Agents pay addresses they have never seen.

segments.text: Your agent is about to pay an address it has never seen. Is that wallet sanctioned?
presign-guard checks it against the US Treasury's own sanctions list. This Tron address: red. It belongs to Bank Markazi, Iran's central bank.
The usual free source says sanctioned: zero, for the very same address.
Any chain works. Vitalik's wallet: green. This one: red. It is the Lazarus Group's, and reported for theft.
Agents pay one cent per screen over x402, on Base, Solana, the XRP Ledger or Algorand. Every answer is signed.
The list itself is free, open data. And sellers get a middleware that turns away a sanctioned payer before the payment settles.
x402 Doctor runs the same screen on the seller's payout address before an agent pays, so it never pays a sanctioned seller either.
